column1: # guard-readers.tsv -- the RGS read contract of this layer: one row per stock
# read our profile depends on. Format: key <TAB> reader-note <TAB> read-expression
# (lines starting with # are comments). On an RGS bump the guard greps the whole
# fix/ shadow tree for every read-expression: the read must SURVIVE the update. A
# move is fine (whole tree, not the file named in the note); a drop is RED. A bare
# key name is too weak: it also appears in comments and in es_features.cfg.
